tasks.title: Status adopts the contract patch after #809 and passes its existing checks
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, R7, all preconditions and Completion evidence; Rollout step 3; Security impact dependency pins; Acceptance evidence 5. Before any edit, require #809 closed, status main's pin containing c5ce6685ce8b563a243823bca451032291b81adb, and compare <pin>...<patch sha> status ahead; otherwise apply the specified holds. Today's status main pins b637302363b3f147a99280e5961396e6c9f22e7a, not c5ce668 exactly, so use ancestry rather than version equality. Preserve the requested native blocked-by #809 rollout dependency for a person to link after fan-out. After these checks and contract merge, bump only package.json and bun.lock to the same full main patch merge SHA as the other consumers (2.5.1 or next free patch). No new tests: status calls none of the changed validators. Include check, accessibility, CI and two-file-only evidence.
